metadata.name: Envelope Subscribe
metadata.description: A newsletter signup where the submit button melts into an envelope, folds, and flies off with a particle trail before a check mark draws itself. A resend countdown follows. Reduced motion falls back to short fades.
metadata.author: vovalopuh13
